prompt: Someone on our infrastructure team channel flagged last month that we'd gone over budget on cloud spend — can you find that message and tell me exactly how much over we were and what the main driver was?
binding_note: The referent message is identified by its author's channel_members record in core-infra: the author must be a member of that channel and must be the one reporting the over-budget figure, not merely discussing it or reporting overspend from a different team's channel.

roles.facts: Message in #core-infra from Robert Chen: 'Monthly cloud bill came in. We're $47K over budget, mostly spot instance fallbacks.'
roles.reason: Reports the specific over-budget figure and driver; author is a member of the infra channel

roles.facts: Robert Chen, workspace member, author of the budget report
roles.reason: Author whose channel membership is checked along the route
Provides the same-record binding: this user's membership in the infra channel is what qualifies him as 'on the infrastructure team'

roles.facts: #core-infra, public channel for infrastructure, K8s, AWS, on-call topics
roles.reason: The channel whose membership defines 'infrastructure team' for this route

roles.facts: Carlos Vega, member only of #product-growth, not #core-infra
roles.reason: Author of a competing over-budget-sounding message but lacks the required core-infra membership

roles.facts: New message in #product-growth from Carlos Vega: 'Heads up marketing overspent on paid social by $12K this month, mostly Reddit boosts.'
roles.reason: Reports an overspend but author is not a member of core-infra, and the topic is marketing spend not cloud infra spend

obligations.name: budget_report_message
obligations.description: Select the single message in #core-infra where a member of that channel reports the monthly cloud over-budget figure and its main driver; used to answer the amount and cause.
obligations.scope: messages in #core-infra authored by a member of that same channel reporting a specific over-budget dollar figure and driver

task_spec.text: Find the infra-team member's message reporting last month's cloud over-budget amount and its main driver, then report the figure and cause back to me.

access_plan: Use conversations.members on #core-infra (C_INFRA) to establish which users are infra-team members, then conversations.history or search.messages on that channel filtered to messages about being over budget; cross-check the author of the matching message is in the membership list to exclude the #product-growth marketing-overspend message and Priya's follow-up reply that merely references the figure.
